decisions.question: Will twitter / x.com be open source before September?
decisions.thinking: With under 22 days remaining, open-sourcing X's full backend and client core is a massive undertaking with no public rollout underway. Market at 10% overestimates the likelihood of a surprise drop in this timeframe.
decisions.uncertainty: Whether Elon Musk made an explicit recent promise or surprise announcement regarding releasing X's full codebase in August 2026.

decisions.question: Will MNX have $1m in volume before September 2026?
decisions.uncertainty: Current cumulative mainnet volume of MNX as of August 10, 2026.

decisions.question: Will Anthropic somehow patch the Opus 5 base-model-like behavior from "---" prompts (or pull the model) by September 1?
decisions.uncertainty: Whether Anthropic's fix will broadly cover all markdown separator variants rather than just the exact string.
